scope: Proposition 3.1 (Triangular conversion) of the manuscript “An explicit counterexample to the Auslander-Reiten conjecture” (preprints/An-explicit-counterexample-to-the-Auslander-Reiten-conjecture-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 199 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 22f6a9d5151fca3a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 6-7. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let A be a finite-dimensional symmetric algebra over a field k of characteristic two, let F be a finite A-bimodule projective on both sides, and let X be a finite left A-module. Suppose v ∈ HomA(X, FX). For each integer a, put Ha = HomA(X, X[a]), Ka = HomA(X, (FX)[a]), and define δa : Ha ⊕ Ha −→ Ka , (g, j) 7−→ F(g)v + v[a]j. (3.1) 6 Assume that δ0 is surjective with nonzero kernel and that δa is an isomorphism for every integer a > 0. Choose an actual map v0 : X → FX representing v and an embedding i : X → Q into a finite projective A-module. Define Λ = A 0 F A ! , Y = (FX ⊕ Q)/{(v0(x), i(x)) : x ∈ X}, Z = (X, Y, ι), (3.2) where ι : FX → Y is induced by the first summand and specifies the structure map of the left triangular module. Then Z is a finite nonprojective Gorenstein-projective left Λ-module and Exta Λ(Z, Z) = 0 = Exta Λ(Z, Λ) for every integer a > 0.
